prompt.project_info: Luxury travel editorial portrait captured from a hot-air balloon over a vast desert landscape.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman leaning back gracefully from the edge of a hot-air-balloon basket, eyes closed and face lifted toward warm sunlight, wearing a white off-shoulder summer blouse, minimal jewelry, natural warm makeup and long wind-flowing dark hair.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium-close portrait with basket edge in foreground, subject in left foreground third, layered desert plateau, winding paths, distant mountains, clear sky and multiple colorful geometric hot-air balloons behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural warm golden-hour directional sunlight with soft sky bounce, controlled highlights, soft desert shadows, serene sun-kissed confidence.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 35mm lens look at f/2.8, subject sharp with distant balloons softened, natural perspective, warm daylight around 5200K, moderate saturation, cinematic highlight roll-off.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic luxury travel editorial portrait of one generic approved adult woman leaning gracefully from a hot-air-balloon basket, eyes closed and face lifted toward golden sunlight, wearing a white off-shoulder summer blouse and minimal jewelry, long dark hair moving in the wind, vast warm desert plateau, distant mountains and 5-7 geometric blue, cream, orange and mustard balloons, 35mm f/2.8, soft cinematic golden-hour grade.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed basket or balloons, visible logos, watermark, logo overlay, blown highlights
